scope: Targeted follow-up of Chile Cámara TV and Jalisco Canal Parlamento, plus the already-recorded Brazil TV Senado linear programme lead.
method: Bounded official HTML/JSON/JavaScript requests and primary-page text verification. No media requests, browser/player execution, playback, third-party guide imports or broad catalogue audit.

checks.cached_primary_reader_observation: A cached official television page contains a separate Programación grid as well as commission listings, but its sample dates were July/August2026 and it is not a current schedule payload.

remaining_holds: Obtain the current official linear programme payload and its explicit broadcast-date contract when normal text access is available.
Do not treat the parallel commission listings as the television sequence.
Do not derive current programme dates from recording dates, historical cached pages, or a third-party TV guide.
records.xmltv_decision: No parser or allowlist addition from unavailable current source data.

records.confirmed: The official live page identifies a Canal Parlamento player separately from its commission/forum/event YouTube coverage. The maintained month agenda lists concurrent institutional activities, not a dated linear TV grid.
remaining_holds: Several different activities share10:00 on1October2026, so next-agenda-start durations would falsely merge parallel events.
No dated single-feed TV programme intervals were found in the maintained agenda or official embedded player text.
The currently embedded player references a different stream host/path from the catalogue; this is metadata drift only, not a fresh stream validation or instruction to replace playback.
records.source_integrity_observation: Unrelated external spam links were present in navigation/footer HTML on both maintained government pages. They were not followed or used as evidence; this does not establish the cause or scope of the website issue.
records.xmltv_decision: No parser or linear allowlist addition; institutional agenda remains separate from broadcast timing.

records.mapping: Only the existing designated on-air TV Senado record receives the official complete linear TV Senado grid. Parallel Senate event webcasts receive no copied programmes. Existing link-out/media/rights policy remains unchanged.

date_contract.date_provenance: Explicit source request dates documented by the official date-picker/AJAX client; the observed API row lists do not echo a separate date field. Different requested dates returned different programme grids.
date_contract.changed_response_rule: HTML, changed JSON wrappers, missing renderer fields, invalid clocks, empty titles, duplicate/backwards clock ordering and unanchored payload counts raise errors rather than become empty schedules.

source_clock.basis: Brasília broadcast clock, corroborated by the official25October election-coverage announcement and the matching14:00 Especial Eleições2026 grid slot. No timezone field is exposed in the observed JSON.
rules: Use the source-zone calendar date for the explicit request, including UTC/new-year rollover.
Use named-zone resolution; ambiguous/nonexistent local clocks raise source errors.
Publish UTC instants with source_timezone; do not depend on the runner or viewer timezone.

end_contract.justification: The official programme page labels this a complete TV Senado schedule and renders each requested date as one strictly ordered Horário/Programa/Episódio/Sinopse table. Adjoining slots within that same complete daily linear table establish the sequential boundary.
limits: Never cross the terminal slot into a following date, even if the following date has listings.
Never bridge an empty/missing day or an invalid/missing middle row.
No fixed duration, arbitrary event-directory sequence or next-room inference.
Keep each daily terminal end unknown; no source-end provenance is claimed for inferred boundaries.

collector_evidence.method: Actual three-day HTTP responses replayed through the real collector, exporter and publication validator. Pending registry/allowlist/catalogue-source metadata were applied only in the isolated test process.

verification.publication_validator: passed on isolated generated ten-product bundle
verification.limitations: Current input evidence establishes dated guide metadata and a single on-air mapping, not media uptime, decoded playback or broader redistribution rights.
